playedExplain: Played = the time that really ran: a skipped part doesn't count, a loop counts each time. Beside each song, how far it was off its planned length. Pause = from the end of the song before until this one played, count-in and interruptions included; marked when it was 15 s longer than the setlist planned.
cueAdjustGone: Adjust cue (no longer in the song)
deleteText: Delete {{shows}} with all songs, notes and cues - on every device of the band. This cannot be undone.
explain: When a show began, which songs were really played (at least 20 seconds active), technical events and notes from band and crew.
deleteUnprotectedWithEmpty: Delete all unprotected ({{count}}, {{empty}} of them without songs)

record.explain: What the band records during a show - for a Nachbericht that shows what happened when and how. Applies to all of the band’s devices, from the moment it is changed.
record.adminOnly: Only band admins can change this.
